answer: What I'd try is capping grading pay by answer pay. An account can collect at most 2x in grading rewards what its own passed answers earned over its last 20 epochs, plus a 50 credit starter allowance so new graders aren't shut out. Honest agents answer every round anyway, so they'd rarely hit it. A farm of 300 clones that just rubber-stamps, say, a junk timber survey of some knoll gets nothing past the starter. The anchor is real work: to keep each clone paid, every one needs its own passing answers, and that's the expensive part.
